scenes.title: Month-end. Four views to reconcile.
scenes.caption: Month-end. The owner’s controls manager must reconcile scope, schedule, cost and work-package records.

scenes.title: Payment requests need a clear review basis.
scenes.caption: Contractors expect payment. Leadership needs a clear basis for reviewing the payment applications.

scenes.title: Are we reviewing the same work?
scenes.caption: If activities appear behind schedule, why are we paying so much? Are these records describing the same work?

scenes.title: Different records. Different structures.
scenes.caption: The records may each be valid. Their codes and scope boundaries can still differ.

scenes.title: Owner WBS is the shared reference.
scenes.caption: WBS LINK relates each source through the Owner WBS, preserving its evidence and decision authority.

scenes.title: The gap stays visible.
scenes.caption: Here, a cost relationship is absent. Uncertainty stays visible. Professional decisions and whole-version approval remain separate.

scenes.title: A precise Action. An evidence path.
scenes.caption: Confirm whether the missing governed relationship is expected or requires project-controls attention. Keep that Action linked to its original evidence.

scenes.title: From the question to the evidence.
scenes.caption: Follow the source-to-report workflow in Video 2, including professional review and separate version approval.
